headline: LeftField to present on School District Priority One Project and give financial report for September 2026.
summary: The committee will hear a presentation from LeftField on the School District Priority One Project. LeftField will also submit a monthly status and financial report for the period ending September 2026.
items: Presentation from LeftField regarding the School District Priority One Project to date.
Monthly status and financial report submitted by LeftField for the period ending September 2026.
Possible motion to accept the report and submit it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School Committee for informational purposes.
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON JOINT SCHOOL BUILDINGS 
October 13, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Bonilla, Fajardo, Thomas 
School Committee Members O'Connell, Turner, Hamer 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Presentation from LeftField regarding the School District Priority One Project to 
date. 
    
2. Monthly status and financial report submitted by LeftField for the period ending 
September 2026. 
If the Committee so desires, a motion is in order to accept the report and 
submit it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School 
Committee for informational purposes. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
